name: groddle/contribute-credits
title: Contribute testers board
description: Thank you, testers: the ten players whose bug reports led to the most changes, by points, read from the report credits each time the page is shown.

how.default: Points come from reports once they are closed: 5 for a fix that keeps saves or accounts safe, 3 for a bug fixed, 2 for an idea that shipped and 1 for a clue or a partial fix. A report that led to several changes earns 1 more for each, up to 8.

empty.default: Nobody is on the board yet. The first reports that lead to a change will put their testers here.
